question: Which of the following not-for-profit organisations runs a flagship programme called Udaan that supports accelerated learning of out of school adolescent girls (aged 11-14 years), as of July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CARE.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• CARE India is a not-for-profit organization that focuses on empowering marginalized communities, especially women and girls.
 
• The Udaan programme is designed to support the accelerated learning of out-of-school adolescent girls aged 11-14 years.
 
• The programme aims to bridge the educational gap for these girls and reintegrate them into the formal education system.
